The following events took place in '''11 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] was rediscovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;[[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations were quickly established.<ref name="TEGASxi">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], p. XI</ref>
*Imperial presence is established on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SoT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref>
*[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] was blackmailed from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and enlisted in the Imperial [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]].
*[[Mikka Reekeene]] released [[Lens Reekeene]] from jail.<ref name="CP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>
*[[Bria Tharen]] joined the [[Cult of The One and The All]] on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]].<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
*[[Muuurgh]] and [[Mrrov]] arrived on Ylesia.<ref name="TPS" />
*[[Colony Three]] was constructed on Ylesia.<ref name="TPS" />
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] won the junior [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] championship for a third time and the entire [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] championship.<ref name="TPS" />

[[File:Maridun_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|[[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]].]]
